description: This PHP file generates the HTML page for displaying the connection status and network configuration details of a Cisco-based gateway device. It includes server-side logic to fetch network status, IP addresses (IPv4 and IPv6), Wi-Fi configurations, MoCA status, WAN details, and dynamically populates the web page with this information, along with embedded JavaScript for client-side interactions.
